panels.title: Memory per container
panels.description: Process memory (anon); excludes reclaimable file cache. Top 6 + other; system = MemTotal minus MemAvailable minus all containers; free = MemAvailable. Full bar = MemTotal.

panels.title: CPU per container
panels.description: 5m average; 100% = one core. Top 6 + other; idle = 100% x cores minus all containers. Full bar = all cores.

panels.title: Top 5 memory
panels.description: Process memory (anon); excludes reclaimable file cache.

panels.title: Network
panels.description: vpn carries all media-app traffic; all = every container.
